problem.title: Three questions many people ask at the end of the month

budget.title: Will my salary last the month?
budget.body: Without tracking expenses, the salary goes without knowing where.

practice.body: Missions are played in your own wallet: a loan leaves installments, paying the minimum adds interest and falling for a scam takes money away. Everything is reversed with actions inside the simulation, and every mistake ends in an explanation.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: No. It is educational content: it teaches concepts and lets you practice with scenarios. It never recommends specific products, institutions or investments.
faq.q2: What does whoever offers Alcancía see about each person?
faq.a2: The organization, the school or the partner see learning progress: guides, challenges and completed levels. Never amounts, balances, habit answers or why a level is still locked.
faq.a3: Not yet. Today scenarios use example values labeled as such, with links to official sources. Real rates, UVA, inflation and exchange rate, with date and source, are planned; the money will stay fictitious and stock and CEDEAR prices will stay as examples.
faq.a4: The wallet companion: it warns before an avoidable mistake, explains after one and celebrates progress. It can be muted.
faq.a5: It is a portfolio prototype with fictitious data and no backend: everything you enter stays in your browser.

profile.title: Investor profile test
profile.intro: Brokers ask for it before opening an account, to offer you products that fit your horizon and how much risk you tolerate. Taking it here shows you what it is like and what it is for.
profile.notAdvice: Educational content. Your result is not a recommendation and never becomes a portfolio: it only helps you understand the questions you will be asked.

meaning.conservative: You put not losing what you invest first, even if it grows less. Brokers usually show low-risk, high-liquidity instruments first.
meaning.moderate: You look for a balance: you accept some ups and downs so your money can grow in the medium term.
meaning.aggressive: You tolerate sharp drops in search of more long-term growth. It still makes sense to invest only money you will not need soon.

profile.why: Your result stays only in this browser. When you open your practice brokerage account in Invest, it is reused.
